name: 3D Gaussian Splatting via Instancing
definition: A technique to generate volumetric data (e.g., velocity fields) by rendering 3D Gaussian splats using instanced rendering, computing the Gaussian function in the fragment shader.
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting via Instancing renders 3D Gaussals by submitting instanced quads to the hardware pipeline, avoiding tile-based rasterization overhead.
